WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_avg_anlycount
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.transref,
    step1.avg_anlycount,
    step1.avg_anlycount - step2.overall_avg_anlycount as diff_from_overall
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.avg_anlycount > step2.overall_avg_anlycount
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_anlycount) as avg_of_step3
  FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  step3.transref,
  step3.avg_anlycount,
  step3.diff_from_overall,
  step3.avg_anlycount - step4.avg_of_step3 as diff_from_step3_avg
FROM step3, step4
ORDER BY diff_from_step3_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
